## Type of change

- [ ] Adding a new entry
- [ ] Updating or fixing an existing entry (broken link, outdated description, etc.)

> **Inclusion criteria** section below.

## Inclusion criteria (required for new entries)

To be added, a project, company, or resource should be **established and actively
maintained**. We generally look for **at least one** of the following. Please check
everything that applies and give us the supporting details.

- [ ] **Maintained for 6+ months** with regular, meaningful activity (commits, releases, posts, episodes, etc.)
- [ ] **Meaningful community adoption** (e.g. several hundred GitHub stars, active contributors beyond the author, real downloads/users)
- [ ] **A significant milestone** (e.g. funding round, acquisition, major conference talk, notable production usage)
- [ ] **Widely recognized** in the network automation community (e.g. referenced by other well-known projects, books, or training)
- [ ] **None of the above, but I believe this deserves an exception** (please explain below)

### Supporting details

## Affiliation

- [ ] I am the author, maintainer, or an employee of what I'm adding
- [ ] I am not affiliated; I'm a user who found it valuable

<!-- Self-promotion is fine when the project meets the criteria above, we just ask that you be upfront about it. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read the [contributing guidelines](../blob/master/contributing.md)
- [ ] The entry is in the correct section and in alphabetical order with a period at the end of the sentence
- [ ] The description is concise and accurate
- [ ] This is not a duplicate of an existing entry
- [ ] I understand that PRs which do not complete this template, or do not meet the inclusion criteria without a reasonable exception, will be closed without further review
